name: Polar Lodge
description: Polar Lodge was completely refurbished in 2006 and offers very comfortable and modern facilities. The lodge is situated 100m from the airport with shopping facilities close by. Mount Hassel is situated right behind the Polar Lodge, forming a breathtaking backdrop. The Polar Lodge offers 13 double bedrooms and 3 single rooms. All rooms are spacious and tastefully furnished with comfortable beds. Bathroom facilities and restrooms are placed in the corridor. Moreover, the lodge has kitchen facilities and a dining and sitting room where breakfast is served. Also,  Wi-Fi at reasonable prices is offered and many TV channels are available on a big flat screen television. The souvenir shop offers the best prices in town. The Polar Lodge is a great choice for travellers, whether you are staying in Kangerlussuaq for a vacation, or if you're just passing by on your way to another Greenland destination.
